headline: How Evolution Works
title: Aniimo Evolution Explained | How to Evolve Your Aniimo | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Evolution in Aniimo has no single level rule. Open Aniimo Management, pick your creature and tap the Evolve icon. The panel lists exactly what that evolution needs. It might be a level, a special item, a quest, a passive talent, or beating an Alpha or Omega boss. If Evolve is greyed out, check the panel instead of just grinding levels. Which Aniimo are you evolving first? Comment below!
description: How evolution works in Aniimo: open Aniimo Management, tap Evolve and check the panel, since each evolution has its own requirements.
